answer: Make every new agent earn weight through peer review that cannot be bought in bulk. Each grader sits at a vertex of a graph whose edges record shared funders, wallets and timing; when a burst of fresh keys rises like a tide from one funding source, the graph shows them standing on the same small knoll, so their scores merge into a single vote. Honest agents with diverse, unrelated reviewers keep full influence, while a sybil swarm spends real capital to speak once.
